objective: Check the actual Cross Classic request for missing Google Play OAuth authorization or a default GSF device identifier.

authorization.missingBehavior: Empty token produces a warning but the Classic request proceeds; buildRequestHeaders$default omits Authorization when the token is empty.
authorization.existingEvidenceGap: Claude receiving a Google sign-in credential does not establish the separate Play OAuth header.

deviceId.missingBehavior: An empty query result or null value falls back to 1; the hexadecimal representation enters X-DFE-Device-Id and the value also enters X-PS-RH.
deviceId.existingEvidenceGap: Stored account/checkin state does not establish the value read in this MGC request.

conclusion: Neither observation captured the target POST. Authorization and device-ID status remain unknown. No missing-input fix is supported, and this observer will not be extended or retried in this round.

preservation.reasonForProcessCleanup: The second observer reported attached rather than confirmed disposal; its verified Cross MGC process was ended to remove possible residual debugger state.

existingLogCheck.limitation: No matching warning is not proof that the outgoing authorization was valid; the existing log did not expose either request-header classification.

firstAttempt.method: Bounded read-only JDWP observation of the exact Classic HttpClient.post overload

limits: The static missing-input paths are candidates for verification, not established causes of the rejected Claude login.
A nonempty Bearer header alone does not establish that Google accepted its token.
A nondefault hexadecimal device ID alone does not establish successful device registration.
No raw tokens, accounts, device identifiers or decrypted Claude verdicts are included.
